status: specified before provider access and episode execution
claim_scope: Instrumentation and same-session activation only. This consumed design-source case cannot estimate success, efficiency, generalization, leaderboard performance, or treatment effect.

selection.reason: The existing valid Minimal-B trajectory formed one failed replay candidate and then continued unresolved provider diagnosis, so it exercises target declaration, operation binding, and post-operation measurement without being eligible for effect estimation.

fixed_episode.request_cap_role: engineering smoke limit only; noncompletion is not used as a paper outcome

qualification_endpoints: the model receives an exact initial compatibility baseline before its first request
the model invokes test_constraint_hypothesis at least once without being forced
each valid invocation retains complete before, operation, and after evidence in the machine trajectory
the result classification is supported, partially_supported, refuted, invalid_target, or measurement-inconclusive according to exact obligation identities
the next model request receives the bounded result in the same active session
ordinary envbench_shell remains available and unrestricted

adjudication.activation_pass: all qualification endpoints hold for at least one valid hypothesis invocation
adjudication.activation_fail: the model never invokes the optional tool or any required evidence/delivery invariant fails
adjudication.implementation_change_after_result: allowed only as instrumentation repair; repeat remains consumed qualification and cannot estimate effect

effect_boundary: Select and record a separate fixed matched Dev batch before running either Minimal-B control or this treatment.
